notes.title: Going Free-to-Play
notes.notes: [p][b]Important Update:[/b] Virus Blast Going Free-to-Play[/p][p]We've made the decision to make Virus Blast completely free-to-play, effective August 5th, 2025.[/p][p]This change reflects our commitment to getting our game into the hands of more players who can enjoy what we've created. Rather than having the game sit behind a paywall with limited reach, we want to share it with the gaming community at large.[/p][p]For our existing players who purchased the game, we thank you for your early support. You helped make this game possible, and we hope you'll continue to enjoy it alongside the new players who will be joining.[/p][p]The game will remain exactly as it is, with all current content available to everyone at no cost. I will not add advertisements or sketchy freemium models.[/p][p]This marks the end of the beginning of our journey as devs. Rooftop Dog Studios has dissolved, and both devs are now working on bigger, more ambitious projects. We truly thank you for being part of our journey.[/p]

notes.title: Update 0.7
notes.notes:
-Tutorial is a little bit easier.
-Tutorial laboratory collision bug fixed.
-Added a collider to Bang as he flies around you (no interaction).
-Fixed a visual bug on game start.
-Fixed a visual bug on tutorial laboratory glass.

notes.title: Update 0.6
notes.notes: Tutorial challenge is now easier than ever, making the game friendlier and more approachable for new players.

notes.title: Update 0.5
notes.notes:
-Slight re balancing of the upgrade prices
-Fixed tutorial exploit, can no longer abuse walls to beat tutorial
-TUTORIAL SKIPPABLE, option can be found while pausing the game on the tutorial.
-Tutorial easier and more approachable for new players
-Other minor SFX bugs fixed

notes.title: Update 0.4
notes.notes:
-Slight re balancing of the last section of the game
-"Money Pow" now needs to be loaded like normal bullets and can only be used once in mid air.
-Fixed minor text bug
-Highscore counter added to the Leaderboards section

notes.title: Update 0.3
notes.notes: -Fixed a bug where the the highscore would fail to upload to the leaderboards

notes.title: Update 0.2
notes.notes:
-Fixed a visual bug with the tutorial boxes shader.
-Fixed a bug where the prosecutor drone was failing to spawn.
-Changed the last upgrade of the game to activate "on click pressed" instead of "click held down" so it´s not so exploitable.
-Re-balanced upgrade costs

notes.title: Update 0.1
notes.notes:
- Fixed the bug where the player would randomly get stuck in a moving cube after being thrown out of an elevator.
-Fixed a visual bug where the Leader-boards wouldn't display long account names.
-Fixed an audio bug created by the "Relog" upgrade particle effect.
-Fixed achievements 13, 14 & 15, now obtainable.
-minor detailed re-design of certain levels.
